title: Loop Health Registry
description: Universal ecosystem-freshness registry: declares, per scheduled producer workflow, how its liveness is proven (proof adapter), that its silence is intentional (allowed_silence), or that it is deliberately disabled for a bounded window (disabled). The ecosystem-freshness monitor reads this to turn the board red for any dead or silent-green loop. See scripts/ecosystem_freshness.py.

default_branch.description: Branch whose commit history is authoritative for git_log proof adapters (default-branch evidence). Defaults to 'master' when omitted.

monitors.description: Scheduled workflows that are freshness/health MONITORS, not producers. Self-excluded from producer coverage so the monitor never flags itself as unregistered.

loops.description: One entry per scheduled producer workflow. Each entry declares exactly one of: proof, allowed_silence, or disabled.

workflowFile.description: Bare workflow filename under .github/workflows/, e.g. demerzel-ideation.yml.

schedule.description: Harvested cron expression (documentation/identity; not re-derived by the monitor).

status.description: active loops must carry proof or allowed_silence; disabled loops must carry a disabled block.

allowed_silence.description: When true, the loop legitimately leaves no committed repo evidence (it delivers value externally, e.g. posting a Discussion). Its silence is neutral, not silent-green. Requires a reason.

reason.description: Human justification (required for allowed_silence entries; greppable acceptance of the monitoring gap).

note.description: Free-form note (e.g. the remediation that would let a silent-green loop graduate to a proof adapter).

proof.description: How the loop proves it is alive from default-branch repository evidence.

adapter.description: state_glob: newest timestamp inside committed JSON/JSONL state files. git_log: last commit touching a path on the default branch (for commit-only-on-change loops).

glob.description: state_glob only: repo-relative glob of committed state files.

timestamp_field.description: state_glob only: the field carrying an ISO-8601 timestamp in each record (top-level object, array element, or JSONL line).

path.description: git_log only: repo-relative path whose last commit dates the loop.

max_stale_days.description: Freshness threshold. Age strictly greater than this many days is stale.

disabled.description: Time-bounded intentional-disable allowlist. Past 'until' the entry is expired and the board turns red so the pause cannot be forgotten.

until.description: Date (inclusive) the disable remains valid through. After this date the entry is an expired disable (red).
